title: GENIE.AI Framework Configuration
description: Configuration file for customizing the GENIE.AI chatbot framework with dual-prompt mechanism for quick help buttons

title.description: Main application title displayed in the UI

value.description: Path to SVG file (for 'file') or inline SVG content (for 'inline')

splash.description: Splash screen image shown while the application boots

type.description: Splash images are file references; inline content is not supported

value.description: Path to the splash image, served from the /config/ directory

theme.description: UI theme and color scheme settings. All accent variants (hover, muted, dark mode) are derived automatically from brandColor via CSS.

brandColor.description: Primary brand color (hex). This is the single source for the entire accent palette.

bg.description: Page background color (overrides the default light gray)

fg.description: Primary text color (overrides the default dark gray)

visual.description: The Living Intelligence decorative layer. Every asset path is served from /config/ so an operator can replace it on the host without an image rebuild.

enabled.description: Whether the decorative layer is active. When false, no rule of the layer applies.

assets.description: Site-root-relative paths of the decoration assets.

hero.description: Hero illustration above the welcome heading.

mesh.description: Surface dot motif behind the welcome screen.

corner.description: Corner network motif in the resources sidebar.

ambient.description: Low-opacity line overlay on the welcome panel (designer ships inactive).

welcomeMessage.description: Custom welcome message for the chatbot, localized.

quickHelp.description: Quick Help button configurations with dual-prompt mechanism

value.description: Path to SVG file or inline SVG content

category.description: ENGLISH name of the category the button scopes to, as the live hierarchy publishes it (e.g. "Taxes & Revenue"); null for general. The hierarchy's database key is accepted too, for configurations written before this spelling.

serviceLabels.description: Optional service labels that narrow the button's scope beneath its category. Each entry must be the ENGLISH name of a service the live knowledge hierarchy publishes (e.g. "Sunni" under "Hadith"); a label the hierarchy does not carry breaks the button's card, the same way an unknown category does.

action.description: The dual-prompt mechanism: visibleText for user, hiddenPrompt for LLM

visibleText.description: Text the user sees in chat, localized.

hiddenPrompt.description: Detailed prompt sent to the LLM, localized.

placement.description: How the entry is rendered: a tile in the welcome grid, or the composer that replaces the Just Chat action.

custom.description: Custom key-value pairs for use case-specific configurations

visibleText.en: What does the Quran say about patience?

hiddenPrompt.en: You are answering as a Qur'anic-content specialist. Answer the question from the Quran repositories: quote or cite the relevant ayat, leading with the most important information. Ground every statement in the provided knowledge-base content. Cite as the sources do: surah and ayah, hadith collection and number, fatwa body and reference. If the content does not cover it, say so plainly; where sources differ, present the differences as they do, without adjudicating.
